title: Interaction System
description: A flexible, Blueprint-first interaction framework — doors, buttons, elevators, pickups — built for fast prototyping and easy extension. Selected for an Epic Games sponsorship — a "Sponsored Content Award and Featured" Marketplace feature — in June 2023.

title: Modular Building System
description: A grid-snapped modular building kit — walls, roofs, railings, and foundations — for assembling structures quickly in single-player worlds.

title: FPS Scope and Reticle Modular Creator
description: A modular toolkit for building custom scopes, reticles, and weapon HUD overlays for Unreal Engine FPS projects — no per-scope custom code required.

image.alt: FPS Scope and Reticle Modular Creator showcase

title: Building System | Multiplayer Ready
description: A networked, replicated building and placement system designed for multiplayer survival and base-building games.

title: Stylized Nature and Environment Biomes
description: A stylized environment asset pack — seasonal biomes, foliage, and nature scatter — for building vibrant, cohesive stylized worlds.

image.alt: Stylized Nature and Environment Biomes showcase
